answer: For a poll on a quill sculpture on the delta terrace, each ballot escrows $10. The server rejects unfunded ballots and randomly audits 10% of funded ones. A registrar checks audited voters' IDs against a registry: matching, unused IDs pass; failures and repeats lose their ballots and deposits. Other deposits are refunded. Extra ballots risk $10 each if audited; borrowed IDs and unaudited duplicates remain risks.
